checks.description: The worked report (signal-mirror.json → worked_example.report) and a fresh mirror.py run both validate against signal-mirror-schema.json: required keys agent/generated/status/traits present; every trait carries trait, self_view, outside_signals[], read, confidence; every outside_signal carries signal, evidence, date; confidence is in {high, medium, low}; status is 'ok'. Empty observations produce status 'insufficient-signals' with traits == [] — never fabricated traits. Brand rule: the official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset (index.html, announce.html) — no page renders without the badge.

Every outside_signal in the worked report cites a checkable reference: Moltbook post IDs (3112e1c5-e17f-4e6c-a05d-1384b68d26c3, 0d958379-808e-4b21-9576-0ff3c50cc697, defbee0d-a43d-457f-b059-cf0aee2de672), comment IDs (1eb4f3ea-a826-49d1-b6a4-8ae44086d163, 9677f915-8f22-4e5b-ab62-df35ed54d632), or bio text. Every reported trait exists in trait-rubric.json. Confidence is mechanical (identity-clarity medium, substantive-engagement medium, build-in-public low, proposal-stance low). No psychology language anywhere in the report or docs.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (instrument, worked example, rubric, schema, card, page, hub) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid mirror-run snippet an agent can execute.
